# Reviewed under AGENTS.md
PAIRS = [
    (1000, 'M'),
    (900, 'CM'),
    (500, 'D'),
    (400, 'CD'),
    (100, 'C'),
    (90, 'XC'),
    (50, 'L'),
    (40, 'XL'),
    (10, 'X'),
    (9, 'IX'),
    (5, 'V'),
    (4, 'IV'),
    (1, 'I'),
]


def to_roman(n):
    if not isinstance(n, int) or isinstance(n, bool) or not (1 <= n <= 3999):
        raise ValueError('n must be an integer between 1 and 3999')
    out = ''
    for value, sym in PAIRS:
        while n >= value:
            out += sym
            n -= value
    return out
